name: qatlas
description: Qatlas combines passive session context, rules, and project state with explicitly started setup, planning, serial execution, and safe administration tools.

interface.shortDescription: Keep context and run work safely
interface.longDescription: Qatlas combines passive infrastructure with explicitly started entry points: qatlas for clarifying a goal from an idea, a task, or a file, shape for new ideas or existing tasks and the backlog scope, serial execution, and review; qatlas-core for setup and rare core administration; qatlas-work for workspace work outside the loop. Session context, rules, scaffold, backlog binding, memory, filing, import, and Git stay together in the plugin. The lead drives exactly one active task, cuts worker assignments, and checks their results. Invoking run alone permits no external or irreversible effect; a concrete external tool operation needs separate, unambiguous authority from the assignment, the task contract, or an applicable agent file.
defaultPrompt: Set up this project with qatlas-core setup.
Check this project with qatlas-core doctor.
Clarify the plan and open questions of this idea with qatlas goal.
Shape this idea with qatlas shape.
Schedule the next work queue with qatlas shape backlog.
Run up to five tasks of this project in sequence with qatlas run.
Settle the open human handoffs with qatlas review.
Show this project's shared Git worktrees with qatlas-work tree.
